scenarios.name: sacrifice-the-original-keeps-the-copy
scenarios.why: Joo Dee's ability costs a creature sacrifice after creating a token copy of itself. Naming the original as the sacrifice puts the printed card in the graveyard, while the token copy stays on the battlefield; a token that leaves the battlefield ceases to exist, so the graveyard holds exactly the original (CR 701.17 sacrifice, CR 704.5d and CR 111.7).

scenarios.name: sacrifice-the-copy-keeps-the-original
scenarios.why: Naming the token copy as the sacrifice leaves the printed Joo Dee on the battlefield; the token that left the battlefield ceases to exist and is not a card, so the graveyard is empty (CR 701.17 sacrifice, CR 704.5d and CR 111.7).
